1: using System;
2: using System.Threading;
3: 
4: namespace LiteFramework
5: {
6:     /// <summary>
7:     /// 流程阶段基类：**进流程即建 CTS 并跑 `RunAsync`、离场即 Cancel + Dispose** （子类只写 `RunAsync`，避免漏掉取消语义）。
8:     /// </summary>
9:     public abstract class ProcedureStageBase<TId, TReq> : IStage<TId, TReq>
10:         where TId : struct
11:     {
12:         private readonly CancellationToken _rootToken;      // 宿主根令牌（default = 无根——纯 L1/工具场景）
13:         private CancellationTokenSource _cts;
14: 
15:         /// <param name="rootToken">宿主根取消令牌；传 default 保持无根语义。</param>
16:         protected ProcedureStageBase(CancellationToken rootToken = default)
17:         {
18:             _rootToken = rootToken;
19:         }
20: 
21:         /// <summary>
22:         /// 宿主根取消令牌（子类只读口）。
23:         /// </summary>
24:         protected CancellationToken RootToken => _rootToken;
25: 
26:         public virtual void OnInit(IStageHost<TId, TReq> m) { }
27: 
28:         public void OnEnter(IStageHost<TId, TReq> m, in TReq req)
29:         {
30:             // 链接根令牌：离场取消（本阶段 CTS）与宿主关闭（根）共用一条取消链；无根时退化为独立 CTS。
31:             _cts = _rootToken == default
32:                 ? new CancellationTokenSource()
33:                 : CancellationTokenSource.CreateLinkedTokenSource(_rootToken);
34:             RunAsync(m, in req, _cts.Token);
35:         }
36: 
37:         public void OnLeave(IStageHost<TId, TReq> m)
38:         {
39:             _cts?.Cancel();
40:             _cts?.Dispose();
41:             _cts = null;
42:         }
43: 
44:         public virtual void OnUpdate(IStageHost<TId, TReq> m, float elapseSeconds) { }
45: 
46:         protected abstract void RunAsync(IStageHost<TId, TReq> m, in TReq req, CancellationToken ct);
47: 
48:         /// <summary>
49:         /// 失败落点：记 Fatal（日志可见）。**不切流程**——错误流转由业务在 catch 里自行
50:         /// `m.Request(ProcedureId.Error, new ProcedureArgs(ex))`（Core 不引用业务类型）。
51:         /// </summary>
52:         protected void Fail(IStageHost<TId, TReq> m, Exception ex, string where)
53:         {
54:             Log.Fatal(ex, where, LogTag.Procedure);
55:         }
56:     }
